title: Bounded remediation: PAIR_CEO_MODEL operator seam (CEO model configurable like every other route)
description: E2E-V1 remediation: resolveDefaultCeoModelEntry previously resolved a hardcoded gpt-6.1-sol — the only reasoning model in the stack with no operator override. On an account whose codex-cli catalog offers gpt-5.6-sol (verified live via codex debug models + bounded codex exec), the CEO pass could never run even though the planner route was configurable via PAIR_PLANNER_MODEL_ROUTE. PAIR_CEO_MODEL adds the missing seam: model-id only (provider stays codex-cli — subscription-only transport preserved), malformed value fails closed FAIL_CLOSED_CEO_MODEL_CONFIG before any catalog read, unset/empty keeps the default. No seeding, no qualification bypass — pure resolution seam, mirrors PAIR_CONVERSATION_MODEL.
